sources.title: GTA 6 weapon ownership explained: How to keep your favorite guns
sources.text: The difference between owned weapons, unowned weapons, and unique weapon variants in GTA 6 Found a cool gun in GTA 6 and want to keep a hold of it for future criminal activities? Then you're going to need to know how weapon ownership works. Just because you came across a firearm in your travels, doesn't mean that you can keep it forever. There are both owned and unowned weapons, and understanding the difference can help ease some frustration the next time you go to manage your loadout in GTA 6 and find that the awesome assault rifle you had a few hours ago has gone missing. Owned weapons must be either purchased from Ammu-Nation stores located all across Leonida or be otherwise gifted to you by a character in one of the GTA 6 Missions . Buying a weapon with Pocket Cash or your BuckMe account will give a copy of it to both Jason and Lucia, regardless of which character made the original purchase. However, the weapons must be modified and equipped independently. If you drop a weapon (a good thing to do while trying to shake your GTA 6 Wanted Level ) then they can always be recovered from the trunk of your personal vehicle or from a weapons locker located at most Ammu-Nation stores around Leonida. Unowned Weapons function a little differently. This classification counts for any weapons that are dropped by enemies or located in the world ambiently (with one exception which I'll get to in a moment). These guns and melee weapons can't be recovered if they are lost, nor can they be owned for long-periods of time or modified at Ammu-Nation stores. If you find yourself Wasted or Busted, they will also be lost forever. The exception here are Unique Weapon Variants , which can be discovered as you explore a certain location (look for a golden gun icon on the minimap to help pinpoint these, typically found at special spots and illegal operation hideouts). While a Unique Weapon Variant in GTA 6 can't be modified, once they have been acquired they are permanently unlocked for both Jason and Lucia regardless of whether you've already purchased the base weapon. You can learn how to store, recover, and equip new weapons to your GTA 6 loadout here. Most Ammu-Nation stores will only carry a small selection of firearms at the beginning of the game. But the more you invest in new weapons, the faster key locations will begin to expand their stock. Over time, based on the number of weapons you purchase globally, you'll find that more guns will become available for purchase. There are also premium Ammu-Nation stores which will sell a wider range of weapons, offer exclusive cosmetic options, and more. sources.title: How to manage your loadout in GTA 6
sources.text: Everything you need to know about managing your loadout in GTA 6, including how to store and recover your favorite guns in your car Unlike previous Grand Theft Auto games, there are now restrictions on how you manage your loadout and how many weapons you can carry at any one time. That means you need to put a bit of effort into thinking about the sorts of weapons you want available to you, both on your person and ready in the trunk of your car. Thankfully, it's pretty easy to understand once you wrap your head around the basics. So I'm going to walk you through everything you need to know about your GTA 6 loadout right now. Regardless of whether you're on-foot or behind the wheel of a vehicle, you can hold L1/LB to open your loadout. This is split between Weapons and Items, and you can cycle between the two tabs with R1/RB. On the Weapons tab of your loadout, you'll find slots for two sidearms, one for your hands, one for equipment, slots for two longarms, one for a melee weapon, and one for explosives. On the Items tab of your loadout there are single slots for: Masks, Headgear, Headwear, Outfits, Bags, Gear, Eyewear, and Smokes. You can hover over any slot on either tab with the right thumbstick and press X/A to equip. You can manage your loadout in GTA 6 while on-foot in one of two ways: Head over to the trunk of your Personal Vehicle in GTA 6 and press Triangle/Y to open it. From there, hold L1/LB when prompted to open up your loadout. Use the thumbstick to move to any of the slots, and then cycle through available weapons and items using left and right on the D-Pad. This will let you swap around any items that you have stored in your trunk, equip any owned sidearms and longarms that you have stored, and more. You can also stow your longarms in GTA 6 by pressing Square/X. Open the GTA 6 Index and head to the weapons tab to locate your closest Ammu-Nation store. Every one of these locations has a weapons locker inside which you can use to manage your owned weapons and transfer them to your personal vehicle's trunk for easier access on the go. sources.title: How to change the time of day in GTA 6
sources.text: It's possible to advance from day to night so long as you follow this one trick If you're taking your first steps into Key Lento right now, you've no doubt realized that the day and night cycle is considerably longer than it ever was in Los Santos. So you are no doubt wondering how to change the time of day in GTA 6. It's possible, but it takes a little effort to do so. The time of day in GTA 6 works dynamically, meaning that it gradually shifts as you're out in the world committing crimes, driving to destinations, and completing activities. There's big changes between day and night beyond the color palette change too. The police response times are a little longer at night, especially if you're far outside of a major city, while you may also find that buildings that you can enter are more likely to be occupied at night rather than day – you know, when the NPCs have jobs to be at. So if you want to change the time of day in GTA 6 for whatever reason, the easiest way to do this is to go and rest up in the bed of your safehouse. Once Jason or Lucia is resting on the mattress, you have the option of pressing Square/X to sleep. From there you can choose to sleep until whatever time of day that you want to. A similar effect will happen if you try to fast travel in GTA 6 across longer destinations. So that's how you can change the time of day in GTA 6, at least until you've got the story wrapped up . Once you're in the endgame, there is one of the GTA 6 cheats which is wholly dedicated to moving the time of day around – but you'll need to unlock that specific functionality before you can do so. sources.title: How to use the GTA 6 Index to find your next objective
sources.text: Want to know where to go next in GTA 6? Then the Index is about to become your best friend There's a lot to see and do in Leonida, to the point that it can be a little overwhelming. That's why it's essential for you to understand how to view tasks, see your goals, and track active missions in GTA 6. The GTA 6 index is an essential part of the game experience, a menu that you're going to spend a lot of time in as you help Jason and Lucia navigate Vice City. Regardless of where you are in the world or what you're doing, pressing the touchpad will allow you to open up the GTA 6 map . The map will display all local activities, stores, missions, and opportunities that you've discovered. However, you can see what else is available to you by using the index bar which runs across the side of the screen. Click Right on the D-pad to open the index in GTA 6 and you'll have the following options: The index shows all of the missions, tasks, and locations that you've discovered. Once you've navigated to what you're looking for on the map or in the index itself, you just need to hover over the task to learn more about it and then click X to set it as an active destination. You can also set a destination while in free roam using Quick Navigation (activated by holding Down on the D-pad and pressing R3 on an in-world marker). It's worth noting that you can only set one active destination at a time, and that you should check both the map and index regularly for new opportunities as you explore – anything newly discovered will be marked in the index by an orange diamond symbol. Tip: While you can only have one active destination set, you can drop multiple markers on the map. Just open the map with the touchpad and press Square on a useful location to leave a marker. sources.title: How to change your criminal profile in GTA 6
sources.text: To improve your criminal profile in Grand Theft Auto 6 , you must play nice. Since it's GTA 6 , though, "playing nice" means shooting folks in the knee rather than in the head. You'll still break the law, but you'll be more polite about it. Here's how to keep the violence to a minimum and reach a professional criminal profile in GTA 6 . The reputation system in GTA 6 is called the criminal profile. Jason's and Lucia's criminal profiles indicate how merciful or violent they are. Make no mistake; a professional (merciful) character still commits crimes, but they won't cause more harm than necessary to secure success. During the main story, you won't notice much difference in gameplay based on your criminal profile, but the game promises it'll have a "lasting impact." In other words, you should expect your criminal profile to affect the ending of GTA 6 . The game also warns you that an "irredeemable" criminal profile may have irreversible consequences, so you might want to avoid that. There are five criminal profile levels in GTA 6 . Here's what they mean: If your character is "professional" or "hardened," they'll receive focus points for hitting non-lethal enemy weak spots . This includes hands, elbows, knees, and feet (which will appear yellow in focus mode). If your character is "violent" or "psycho," they'll receive focus points for hitting lethal weak spots , which include the enemy's head and heart region. Lethal weak spots appear red while using focus mode. To check your character's current criminal profile , use the Jason & Lucia menu or hold right on the D-pad. Beware that criminal profile scores are counted separately for each character. Jason can be "psycho" while Lucia is "professional" at the same time. Criminal profile levels in GTA 6 work like a scale; the less aggressive your behavior, the more you'll move toward "professional." This means that changing your criminal profile for better or worse takes time. If you're currently "professional" and go on a killing spree, you won't drop to "violent" straight away, and vice versa. So, if you'd like to improve your criminal profile, stick to this behavior for a while: Now if you want to worsen your criminal profile, you need to essentially do the opposite of everything listed above. Drive recklessly, aim for the head, and make sure there are witnesses.
